## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

This 1-fascicle anonymous text is the parallel translation of the same essential material as *[Tài zǐ shuā hù jīng 太子刷護經](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6f/KR6f0035)* (T0343, Zhú Fǎhù's version), preserved without translator-attribution. The Taishō apparatus places it in the Western-Jìn / Eastern-Jìn period bracket.

**Abstract**

The bracket adopted here (266 – 420) reflects the broad Western-Jìn / Eastern-Jìn period in which the work was likely produced.

The Taishō text (T0344) is established on the standard apparatus.
